ns2:section.sectionText: This course will combine a series of lectures with extensive hands on fieldwork to teach students about the structure, function, and conservation of marine ecosystems. The course will take place on the island of Eleuthera, in The Bahamas. Students will participate in several days of hands-on field activities to learn about the distribution and abundance of marine organisms, and how human activities can impact marine diversity. Course fees are expected to be approximately $2300 per student.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
